fusions.name: Folded-Wing Slam
fusions.desc: Wraps your wings tight and slams the target for a blow that deals 15 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flung Scale
fusions.desc: A thrown scale that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Shingled Hang
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Overlap
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%. When your health falls below 50%, your attacks heal you for 25% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
